title: A calmer, learning-first academy
summary: Redesigned the dashboard and shared visual system with warm backgrounds, emerald lesson cards, clearer course progress and rounded navigation.

changes.detail: Updated shared light palette, card and control radii, page spacing and section headers.
Rebuilt the dashboard hierarchy around the next lesson; restyled search, shortcut cards, course cards and bottom navigation.
Course cards now show actual completion progress bars.
Removed the change-history block from the top of Home; it remains visible below learning content with every report preserved.

validation.name: Implementation
validation.detail: Typecheck, focused lint and history tests pending. Native device appearance and production deployment are not verified.
